meta.parties: Sreenivasaraghava Iyengar v. Jainambeebee Ammal Et Al

rules.statement: A document purporting to be a 'true copy' of a copy of the original power of attorney copied by a registering officer in a book kept under the Indian Registration Act, 1908 is not in itself sufficient to establish the fact of execution of the original power of attorney when it does not come under section 85 or section 78(6) of the Evidence Ordinance and when it is inadmissible under section 82.
